faq.title: Questions about my services
faq.text: Can’t see yours? [Drop me a line](#contatti) and I’ll reply by the next business day.

items.question: Can I pick just one service?
items.answer: Of course. Every service works on its own. If I think another one would get you better results I’ll say so, but it’s your call.

items.question: Is it worth combining services?
items.answer: Yes: working on your website, SEO and ads together avoids doing things twice, and the results compound. You get one overall price, always fixed.

items.question: Can I combine the launch offers?
items.answer: Each offer applies to its own service. If several catch your eye, we’ll put together the best-value package on the free call.

items.question: Do you only work in Veneto and Friuli?
items.answer: Not at all. I’m happy to meet clients in Veneto and Friuli Venezia Giulia in person, but I work remotely with clients across Italy and abroad, in English, Italian, German and Spanish.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: With a free 25-minute call: you tell me where you are and where you want to be, I tell you what I’d do and what it costs. No obligation.
